recommendation_reason: Fit disqualifier, not inactivity: they already run a live, maintained, multi-page site with insurance content, and have in-house ICT. The pipeline's product (a one-page site with WhatsApp booking) is a downgrade, and the recorded WhatsApp number does not exist. Only a booking-funnel rebuild at professional-services pricing would be an honest offer — a different product.

outreach.reason: Do not contact on the current premise. 'No site of yours' is false and the WhatsApp channel in the dossier is a landline extension; sending the draft would burn the lead.
outreach.if_reopened: Only as a booking / report-request funnel rebuild, pitched to Dr. Unni Miyengi (CEO) via info@vitalray.com or the switchboard — never as 'you have no website'.
